title: Whether licks were the same in each chorus every time
summary: Dutcher presses whether the licks fell in the same chorus each time. Ridgley says parts were fixed and played the same way each time, so the band knew what to expect.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom
